title: Per-tenant token escrow ledger and fail-safe allocator
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Late-arriving token events, partial worker failures, and transient duplicates are producing skewed per-tenant usage that privileges immediate writes to the billing ledger. We need a streaming-first, per-tenant escrow ledger that: (1) stages token allocations from multiple ingress paths, (2) exposes an idempotent commit/settle flow for downstream billing finalization, and (3) includes a fail-safe allocator that caps provisional consumption to protect tenant quotas and reserved capacity.
background: Current ingestion writes directly into the final token ledger which complicates rollback and results in either overcharging or manual interventions when downstream enrichment (route normalization, multi-model attribution) changes. Our goal is to introduce a short-lived escrow stage in the pipeline with clear semantics for provisional vs committed tokens, aligned with existing billing windows and the real-time quota service.
design_notes: Escrow ledger implemented as a Kafka topic per-region with compacted partitions and tenant keying; each message is a single flat event describing provisional token delta and provenance.
Allocator service performs conservative provisional allocation: uses tenant’s active quota, reserved capacity budget, and recent usage velocity to cap provisional tokens until commit window closes.

Commit protocol: downstream enrichment jobs emit a canonical 'commit' message referencing escrow event ids. The escrow consumer atomically moves provisional delta into the canonical billing ledger and writes a tombstone for the provisional entry.
Idempotency: escrow events have digest and monotonic sequence id per-session to allow safe replay and deduplication on consumer restarts.
Observability: add per-tenant provisional/committed counters to Console metrics and a dashboard showing escrow head-latency, outstanding provisional ratio, and allocation rejections.

Fallback: if commit never arrives within TTL (default 6 hours), the allocator triggers either auto-commit with confidence scoring or an adjudication job that surfaces the edge-case to billing ops depending on tenant settings.
Security: escrow topic encrypted at rest; commit ACLs restricted to enrichment and billing services; security review required for cross-account telemetry links.
acceptance_criteria: Introduce escrow topic and verifier consumer that writes provisional entries without modifying final billing ledger
Allocator enforces per-tenant cap and produces allocation-reject events when limits exceeded
Commit messages atomically convert provisional entries to committed ledger rows with end-to-end idempotency (replay safe)
Dashboard surfaces escrow metrics and anomalies; at least two alert rules created (outstanding-provisional>5% for >15m, commit-latency>2h)
E2E tests: simulate late-arrival commits, consumer restarts, duplicate ingress; final totals match golden set in >99.9% of cases
Migration path documented and runbook for failed auto-commits and manual adjudication added to Confluence
migration_plan: Phase 1: dual-write ingress -> (current ledger + escrow) for 2 weeks under shadow. Phase 2: enable allocator to reject >cap provisional in a small canary tenant group. Phase 3: flip enrichment to commit path and remove shadow writes once histograms align within thresholds.
testing_plan: Unit tests for allocator capping and idempotency logic
Integration test harness with kinesis/kafka emulator to simulate out-of-order commits
Chaos test: kill N consumers mid-cycle to validate replay and tombstone semantics
Load test: validate escrow topic steady write of 15k messages/s with <200ms tail latency

2026-02-25 - Priya Nair (SRE): Raised concern about compacted topic retention on cross-region replication. Decided to use per-region escrow topics with periodic reconciler instead of global compacted topic.
2026-03-01 - Evan Chen (Billing): Reviewed commit protocol. Requested strong guarantees around eventual uniqueness of commit ids and a canonical source-of-truth header for enrichment jobs.
